queryName: Beta - Self-hosted Runner Used in Pull Request Workflow
descriptionText: A workflow triggered by pull_request or pull_request_target uses a self-hosted runner. Fork PRs can trigger these events, causing untrusted code to run on the persistent self-hosted machine. Unlike GitHub-hosted runners, self-hosted runners may have access to internal networks, stored credentials, and deployment keys. An attacker can exfiltrate secrets or pivot to internal systems. Use GitHub-hosted runners for any job that may process untrusted fork contributions.
